cast.characterName: レオパルド マーラ
cast.originalCharacterName: レオパルド マーラ

segments.text: A student of the great monster girl tamer Bastal Batch his only experience with taming monster girls is from his studies. A Captain Vanilla confuses him for his teacher, knocks him out, and drags him to Squid Paradise to help free the girls from their curse and rule by Baron Squid.
He can tame monster girls by having them look into his eyes and repeating a contract spell. Once tamed a monster girl will be loyal to him forever.

cast.characterName: キャプテン バニラ
cast.originalCharacterName: キャプテン バニラ

segments.text: A Captain Vanilla type monster girl. Captain Vanilla monster girls have the appearance of pirates. This Captain Vanilla lives on a ship with her friend a Kusushi type monster girl. She fights against Baron Squid and all the monster girls who ally with him.
She's sensitive about her height.

cast.characterName: キャプテン バニラ
cast.originalCharacterName: キャプテン バニラ

segments.text: Captain Vanilla after she dies and is reborn from having sex with Leo. She's much sweeter to Leo than her adult form though she keeps her fierce personality. She is even more sensitive about her height. She loves sweets.

A Kusushi type monster girl. Kusushi means 'doctor' and Kusushis are healers and herbalist monster girls. This Kusushi is a friend of Vanilla and the two lead a rebellion against Baron Squid. She helps out by selling medicines and items and later on works in battle as a healer and support.
She takes care of monster girls which Leo makes pregnant to make sure their eggs are delivered safely.
Kusushi after she dies and is reborn from having sex with Leo. Leo notes that she's much sweeter as a child than as an adult although she refuses to call him 'papa'.
Even as a child she's responsible for the health of the other monster girls.

A Kyankyan type monster girl. Kyankyans are bunny girls that are common throughout Alicesoft games. This Kyankyan can be found playing in the forest and is the first monster girl Leo is likely to find. Although she appears weak and cannot attack enemies herself she's a valuable ally for Leo to find. She loves carrots, perhaps too much.
This Kyankyan loves to play and have sex and although she knows that Leo's semen is poison she constantly begs him to have sex with her and asks him to ejaculate inside her anyway.

Kyankyan after she dies and is reborn from having sex with Leo. She reverts to extreme childishness compared to her adult form. She always wants to play games even in circumstances where it's not appropriate such as dungeons. She always calls Leo 'papa'.

A Yamorin type monster girl. Yamorin are lizard monster girls and Yamorin means 'gecko'. This Yamorin is very strong and wants to become stronger like her father, a Kiteclone type monster. She has a very dangerous kick.
Yamorin after she dies and is reborn from having sex with Leo. She's a bit more playful than as an adult and enjoys collecting mushrooms.

A Maid-san type monster girl. This Maid-san serves a hanni out in the woods. Since she has no formal attachment to the hanni that she serves Leo is able to tame her as his own. Afterward she serves Leo to the best of her ability in everything that a proper maid should serve her master in even if Leo is embarrassed about it.

Maid-san after she dies and is reborn from having sex with Leo. She's very shy unlike her adult form and because of her small size she is unable to serve as a maid. She can't wait to grow up so she can serve Leo again.

A Sketch type monster girl. Leo finds this Sketch in a dungeon. Her drawings come to life and although she tries hard everything she draws looks like childish scribblings. She can also attack with her enormous pencil.

Sketch after she dies and is reborn from having sex with Leo. Unlike her adult form it appears she cannot make her drawings come to life. She also uses crayons to draw instead of a pencil. She calls Leo 'papa' and demands money from him. She claims it's because she's a criminal.

A Sexy Knight type monster girl. Leo finds her hiding in the dark. Although she's a very strong warrior she's incredibly embarrassed about her skimpy clothing. Unfortunately because she's a Sexy Knight she can't do anything about her clothing.
She loves being an ally of justice but has very odd ideas about how an ally of justice is supposed to behave.
Sexy Knight after she dies and is reborn from having sex with Leo. As a child she's incredibly quiet and almost never speaks.

A Sour type monster girl. Sour monster girls look like magical girls or cute witches. This Sour type monster girl was captured by Baron Squid who sexually tortured her in order to force her to kill Leo. She's defeated by Valkyrie and then tamed by Leo.
Sour after she dies and is reborn from having sex with Leo. She acts shy around her 'papa' Leo and shows no sign of a split personality.

A Yama no Sachi type monster. Yama no Sachi are a type of mountain cat monsters. This Yama no Sachi is very playful and loves to eat. She keeps begging the other monster girls who have pets to feed her their pets and is disappointed when they won't let her eat them. She's very friendly.
Yama no Sachi after she dies and is reborn from having sex with Leo. She calls Leo 'chichi', a very informal way of addressing one's father.

A Conte type monster girl. This Conte appears to have died and lives now as a ghost. Whether all Conte monster girls are ghost types is never explained. After finding her grave Leo is able to capture and tame her. She is very skilled at dark magic.
Oddly enough despite being dead she is still capable of having sex, laying eggs, and being reborn again as a ghost.
Conte after she dies and is reborn from having sex with Leo. She maintains the same personality she had as an adult.
She loves quiet places and darkness unlike her adult form that prefers warmth and daylight.

A Kameko type monster girl. This Kameko lives at the beach and is a very strong fighter. Her shell is also incredibly tough which makes her almost impossible to harm however she's so shy that it's easy for Leo to defeat and capture her.

Kameko after she dies and is reborn from having sex with Leo. A bright and cheerful child she displays none of the shyness she has as an adult although she seems to only be able to speak the word 'Kame'.

A Chouchin type monster girl. Chouchin are similar to anglerfish and this Chouchin has a light on her head. She was sexually tortured by Baron Squid in an effort to force her loyalty in murdering Leo. She is a very kindhearted girl however and desperately hopes to be captured by Leo rather than have to kill anyone. Still, because of her deep fear of Baron Squid she still tries to defeat him.
Chouchin after she dies and is reborn from having sex with Leo. She's much more playful as a child and shows none of the reserved characteristics of her adult form.

A Frozen type monster girl. Leo sees this Frozen wandering the pyramid on Squid Island looking for her dog Shiro-chan. A very polite Yamato Nadeshiko type monster girl she only attacks Leo because she's worried that if he captures her she won't find Shiro-chan.
Frozen after she dies and is reborn from having sex with Leo. She's a bit less refined than her older self and can snap at Leo when angry. She's still very polite in her speech though.

A Nekomatamata type monster girl. This Nekomatamata is aloof and just wants to fight to prove her strength and ability. She's incredibly strong and can even beat up dozens of monsters at once. Whether they live is of no concern to her.
She's actually very shy and unsure of herself but puts on a defensive front. When she becomes too afraid that she's fallen in love with Leo she even runs away.

Nekomatamata after she dies and is reborn from having sex with Leo. Somehow when she's reborn she becomes an entire litter of children instead of one like all the other monster girls. They seem to each have their own personalities although because they all talk at once it's hard to tell.
Somehow when she grows up she reverts to being one person again.

A Chapuchapu type monster girl. She's a swimming type monster girl (Chapuchapu means splish-splash) and Leo finds this Chapuchapu at the beach. This Chapuchapu is incredibly creepy, she just wants to kill herself already but Leo won't let her commit suicide so she's often depressed. She enjoys bondage sex and being tortured.
Chapuchapu after she dies and is reborn from having sex with Leo. She's really excited to have died but she doesn't seem too happy that she got reborn again. She doesn't say much other than Uuuuu.

A Zukappa type monster girl. Zukappa seems to be similar to the Kappa monsters of Japanese folklore and Leo finds this Zukappa at the beach drinking. Surprisingly she's a very good healer for Leo as well rivaling Kusushi. She seems to have been rather promiscuous prior to meeting Leo.

Zukappa after she dies and is reborn from having sex with Leo. An energetic and fun loving child she still loves to drink. However because she's underage she carries milk in her gourd instead of sake.

An Umi no Sachi type monster girl. Umi no Sachi are underwater fish monster girls and she seems to have fins instead of ears. Leo finds this Umi no Sachi hiding in an underwater temple. Although she is shy she's still fiercely protective of her underwater home and attacks Leo with the dangerous Fish Sword (Sakana no Sword).
A hidden character not necessary to finish the game this Umi no Sachi still has a proper route and ending like all the other monster girls.

actors.name: あおきさやか(青木静香)

segments.text: Umi no Sachi after she dies and is reborn from having sex with Leo. An affectionate girl she calls Leo 'tou-tama'.

A Hebisan type monster girl. Leo finds this Hebisan in the forest raping a tied up helpless Erina. Typically a lesbian she would much rather have sex with the other monster girls Leo has captured however she's not against the idea of having sex with Leo although it's difficult for her to bring herself to do so.

Hebisan after she dies and is reborn from having sex with Leo. As a child she's extremely shy and demure. The difference in personality is so severe Leo is shocked that she's even the same person. She calls Leo 'papa'.

A Kotodama type monster girl. Kotodama monster girls look like typical high school girls. This Kotodama loves singing and hopes to be an idol however her singing is so unbelievably terrible it can cause physical damage to anyone listening to it. Her only fans are masochists who want their ears to bleed.
Kotodama after she dies and is reborn from having sex with Leo. Although she still carries her microphone and can use singing attacks during battle we never see her actually speak.

A Magician type monster girl. This Magician is found in the forest searching for Leo in the fog whom she's heard about and wants to defeat. Although a terrific magician and very strong in combat she actually has very low self esteem.
Magician after she dies and is reborn from having sex with Leo. The only thing visible on her is her eyes making her hair color or attributes unknown. She calls Leo otou-sama.

A Tokkouchan type monster girl. Tokkouchan type monster girls appear to be fighting miko. This Tokkouchan has a very dangerous attack that can incapacitate an enemy with one strike making her very difficult to beat. She doesn't attack Leo out of malice but for the sake of her honor as a warrior.

Tokkouchan after she dies and is reborn from having sex with Leo. She is still very polite as a child. She pushes herself very hard to become a better warrior as she is growing. She calls Leo Chichi-ue, an old fashioned way to address one's father.

A Harimaou type monster girl. This Harimaou works as a doctor for sick or injured monsters. An incredible slut her most common prescription for the sick or injured is to have sex with them. This creates a long line outside her clinic where monsters injure themselves or act sick in order to have sex with her. She refuses to even wear underwear so that she can have sex all the time and she'll even bother Leo in dungeons to have sex with her publicly in the open. Unfortunately for her he always refuses to have sex in front of others.

Harimaou after she dies and is reborn from having sex with Leo. Her personality remains largely unchanged however and as a child she begs Leo to have sex with her because she wants to break the taboos of sex with children and incest at the same time but he refuses.

A Sulphur type monster girl. Sulphur type monster girls are warriors and this Sulphur is incredibly confident of her abilities. She thinks combat with Leo is beneath her and it takes considerable effort for Leo to convince her to fight him.
Sulphur after she dies and is reborn from having sex with Leo. Still a lesbian she tries to use the advantage that she's an 'innocent' child to grope or molest the other monster girls.

A Valkyrie type monster girl. Although she doesn't work directly with Vanilla or Kusushi she also fights against Baron Squid and helps Leo on his journey to capture all the monster girls of Squid Paradise before Baron Squid can marry them. A very fierce warrior she is one of the strongest monster girls on Squid Paradise.
Valkyrie after she dies and is reborn from having sex with Leo. She acts much like she does as an adult and is still very strong which surprises Leo. She doesn't like Leo treating her as a child.

A Battle Note type monster girl. This Battle Note is one of Baron Squid's most trusted and fierce warriors. She is happy when Baron Squid finally gives up trying to marry the other girls of Squid Paradise in order to propose to her because she hopes to marry someone strong. Her biggest enemy and threat is Valkyrie.
When Lady Killer tries to murder Leo she recognizes Leo's strength and kindness and switches sides killing Lady Killer in the process.

Battle Note after she dies and is reborn from having sex with Leo. As a child she has difficulty speaking and ends her sentences with ~myu which frustrates and annoys her. Because Leo finds it so cute it annoys her even more.

A Kaminari Taiko type monster girl. Kaminari Taiko means thunder drum and this Kaminari Taiko carries a drum which she can use to summon vicious lightning attacks. A very tough wizard she attacks Leo early and often for Baron Squid but is always thwarted by Valkyrie.
Kaminari Taiko after she dies and is reborn from having sex with Leo. She enjoys tormenting and attacking Leo with lightning attacks and playing her drums indoors.

A Hazure Onna type monster girl. Hazure Onna means failure woman and this Hazure Onna is ugly and terrifying. Kira warns Leo to avoid her at all cost. She will force herself into Leo's party, is a terrible warrior, and spends most of the time screaming. She's best avoided.

A Kamikaze type monster girl. This Kamikaze will appear randomly in dungeons and challenge Leo on second playthroughs. She's looking for a strong master to join. Because Leo cannot choose to ejaculate inside her she will never become pregnant and has no child version.

A Kaminagahime type monster girl. Kaminagahime means long haired princess and likely refers to the folktale of Rapunzel. She can be found in the second playthrough and Leo finds this Kaminagahime being bothered by a Freedom type monster who cannot defeat her to make her his girlfriend. She considers her contract with Leo to be a marriage ceremony.
Because Leo cannot choose to have vaginal sex with her she will never become pregnant and has no child version.

A Kraken type monster girl. This Kraken is Baron Squid's most loyal ally although he doesn't seem to realize it. She will do most anything to protect him although she refuses to fight Leo, Vanilla, Kusushi, Valkyrie or their allies. She just wants Baron Squid to be good.

The main antagonist of Galzoo Island. He setup the island as Squid Paradise in order to find himself a bride. He gathers up monster girls and curses them all to be unable to become pregnant or die until he chooses a bride.

An incubus type monster Kira fights against Baron Squid in his own way by supporting Leo and his allies. Many monster girls are in love with him which makes it hard on Leo whenever he comes to assist him.

A water fairy type monster girl. Youko spends most of her time in or near fountains. She does not fight for or against Baron Squid and seems to be the only neutral monster girl on Squid Paradise. She asks Leo for favors along his journey and asks to have sex with him in exchange but he refuses so she gives him powerup items instead.
Lady Killer is one of Baron Squid's loyal allies. He enjoys murder.

Erina is a monster girl tamer and the daughter of the famous monster girl tamer Bastal Batch. When she discovers that Leo was dragged off to Squid Paradise to rescue the monster girls there from Baron Squid she goes there herself with her loyal monster girl Tenten. She competes with Leo for the monster girls and will capture them herself if he's too slow.
Late in the game she's captured by Baron Squid and held captive until she agrees to sign a contract to lose her humanity and become a monster girl.

After Erina is capture by Baron Squid he tries to force her to give up her humanity and become a monster girl. If Leo is too slow in rescuing her she becomes a monster girl, is forced to marry Baron Squid, and becomes pregnant with his child. In the end Leo tames her as his own monster girl.

Tenten is Erina's monster girl. She loves everything about her master and even has sex with her when encouraged by the magic eye in the Pyramids. She's disappointed that Erina doesn't have sex with her more often.
A maid-san type monster girl just like Maid-san. She belongs to Leo's teacher Bastal Batch. She helps train Leo as a monster girl tamer
A Hanny living in the Local Forest, served by Maid Lady. He and his group of loyalist hannies seek vengeance against Kira the Devil, who wiped out most of Kuranosuke's village.

The official mascot of Alice Soft. A polite young girl who often communicates with the player as a medium in some Alice Soft games. She sometimes represent marketing upcoming Alice Soft games in trailers and advertisements.
She is accompanied by her pet black crow named Yukichi.

A small demon monster girl Leo can find in the second playthrough. She carries a scythe and is obsessed with killing. Her hobby is killing. Her favorite thing is killing. She hates not killing. She lives to kill.

During sex she refuses to allow Leo to use MX potions that prevent his semen from being poison so he's forced to kill her with no hope of rebirth. However since she's a monster girl of death she won't die. This means she never becomes pregnant and has no child version.

Pluepet is a talented merchant born in the free city of Portugal in GI980. He travels to all sorts of places as a travelling merchant selling rare goods. He appeared in most Rance games after the 4.x games, and also made appearances in Toushin Toshi games.

He's a strange green creature that travels around in something that resembles a spaceship. His race is unknown but he's probably some rare type of monster. Personality-wise, he's a businessman. He's a very skilled and clever individual that knows how to trade, but he's also very cruel and cold, showing no interest in everything outside of selling his goods and making money. He completely lacks morality and will do whatever he considers will bring the best earning, regardless if it's selling drugs, slaves or innocent girls as prostitutes. He simply sees everything around him as a means to trade and increase profits, and is perfectly fine with helping people as well if he thinks it will be profitable.
From AliceSoft Wiki
